source.title: City of Vancouver Zoning and Development By-law, RT-3 District Schedule (consolidation dated June 2026)
source.section: s.3.1.1.1: maximum FSR 0.60; the Director of Planning may increase it to 0.75 (multiple dwelling, duplex, single detached house, rooming house and others) or 0.95 for infill retaining an existing building (conditional). s.3.1.1.2: 1.00 for multiple dwelling and seniors housing where at least 25% of the units are owned or leased by a government or non-profit housing society and secured as housing for persons with disabilities or low income. Multiple dwelling is a conditional use (s.2.1).

source.title: City of Vancouver Zoning and Development By-law, RT-3 District Schedule (consolidation dated June 2026)
source.section: s.3.1.2.3: maximum building height 10.7 m and 3 storeys; s.3.1.2.11: the third storey must be a partial storey not exceeding 50% of the storey below; s.3.1.2.12: the Director of Planning may increase it (to at most 11.9 m on a site below street grade).
source.read_from: inbox/zoning-by-law-district-schedule-rt-3.pdf (saved by hand from the by-law site), pages 8 and 9

params.front_yard_note: The minimum front yard is the average of the front yards of the 2 adjacent sites on each side (a vacant adjacent site counts as 3.7 m); the maximum front yard is 3.7 m. No fixed minimum is entered, so the front is not tested.
params.side_yard_note: 1.5 m where the site is wider than 15.0 m; 10% of the site width where it is 15.0 m or less.
params.rear_yard_note: 20.0 m, less the distance from the rear property line to the ultimate centre line of a lane behind.

source.title: City of Vancouver Zoning and Development By-law, RT-3 District Schedule (consolidation dated June 2026)
source.section: s.3.1.2.4 and 3.1.2.5 (front yard: average of the adjacent sites, at most 3.7 m), s.3.1.2.6 (side yard: 10% of the site width up to 15.0 m wide, else 1.5 m), s.3.1.2.7 and 3.1.2.17 (rear yard 20.0 m, reduced by the distance to the lane's ultimate centre line), s.3.1.2.8 (site coverage 45%); s.3.1.2.21 lets the Director of Planning vary them for affordable housing meeting s.3.1.1.2.
